summary: Diamondback Energy filed an 8-K on September 29-30, 2026, amending its September 10, 2024 Stockholders Agreement with SGF FANG Holdings, LP, which revises the Stephens Majority's board designation rights: two directors if Stephens Stockholders beneficially own at least 10% but less than 25% of Outstanding Shares, and none below 10%. Concurrently, directors Darin Holderness and Lance Robertson resigned September 29 and 30, 2026, respectively, in a Board Stepdown triggered by the ownership-based reduction, with no disagreement cited. Watch for further Stephens stock sales, board composition shifts, and whether governance changes precede a broader stake exit.
